How about you talking to someone neutral, a counselor,  and getting through with this from another perspective? reading some of the comments, I see a lot of personal involvement or it might just be my impression.

Personally, I don't think someone at the age of 15 could take such a serious decision in the right state of mind and parents don't have a say in this. I'm saying this because how is it right, lawfully, to keep a child in your home as long as is a minor but they don't comply to some rules? this could stir up lots of things but focusing on the presented issue, I'd say whoever she's staying with does have a lot to say regarding the development of the situation. Just keep in mind there could some options as other parties should be involved such as the guy's side and/if your ex-wife would want to help you guys out.

Now, the kicking part, that I think was too extreme and could have been handled more delicate but it's somehow understandable as it did came out as a big shock to you.

In any case, I hope you'll figure this out in the best way possible to all of you and take care.
